facts.statement: The XDF contains about 5,500 galaxies, in a patch of sky that is a small fraction of the angular diameter of the full Moon.

source.title: Hubble Goes to the eXtreme to Assemble Farthest Ever View of the Universe

facts.statement: Hubble pointed at the patch in repeat visits over 10 years for a total of 50 days (2 million seconds of exposure); more than 2,000 images were combined into the XDF.

source.title: Hubble Goes to the eXtreme to Assemble Farthest Ever View of the Universe

facts.statement: The XDF reveals galaxies that span back 13.2 billion years in time; most are seen when they were young, small and growing.

source.title: Hubble Goes to the eXtreme to Assemble Farthest Ever View of the Universe
